newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf jet fuel differentials seen near steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf jet fuel differentials seen near steady.

text.p: U.S. Gulf jet fuel differentials held their ground Tuesday, hovering near the top of the recent trading range.
On the NYMEX, August heating oil futures gained 0.17 cent to end at 54.31 cents and the September contract gained 0.16 cent to finish at 54.67 cents.
U.S. Gulf prompt 54-grade jet fuel changed hands at 0.30, 0.40 and 0.45 cents over the August NYMEX price.
"There's been some good action today despite the Merc," one player said, referring to the narrow trading range made by the futures.
